english.note: A speaker uses this fuller form when naming the pasta or dish more explicitly than 意粉.
Use the full name when you want to specify the pasta itself rather than rely on the shorter everyday form.

examples.english: I bought a pack of spaghetti to take home.
examples.traditional: 我買咗包意大利粉返屋企。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 baau1 ji3 daai6 lei6 fan2 faan1 uk1 kei2

examples.english: How long does that packet of pasta from the supermarket need to cook?
examples.traditional: 超市嗰包意大利粉要煮幾耐？
examples.jyutping: ciu1 si5 go2 baau1 ji3 daai6 lei6 fan2 jiu3 zyu2 gei2 noi6
